en: Black‑and‑white view of a small half‑timbered cottage with a tiled gable roof and four front windows decorated with lace curtains and flower boxes. The house stands on a slightly raised foundation with steps leading up. In the foreground is a gravel yard with a wooden well or pump and a bench beneath a leafy tree. Dense trees and foliage surround the building, giving a rural, wooded setting. There is a vertical string of numbers or marks along the right edge that looks like a photographer's or publisher's notation.
